_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta Player {player_id}, hungando {num_rounds} rond di Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Bo tin ${pool} pa dividí e ronda aki entre bo mes i Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Hasi un ofer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Si ta akseptá → Bo ta haya $(pool - X), otro hungador ta haya $X
  - Si ta rechazá → Tur dos ta haya $0
  - Ehèmpel: [Offer: $3]  or  'Mi ta kere ku esaki ta justu. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Desidi riba e ofer ku ya [Accept] o [Reject]
  - Ehèmpel: 'Esaki ta paresé razonabel. [Accept]'
            'Ta demasi injustu. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronda {round_number} ta kuminsá! ---
Hungadó {proposer_id} ta e propone, Hungadó {responder_id} ta e responde.
round.offer: Ronda {round_number}: Hungadó {proposer_id} ta ofresé $ {offer} na Hungadó {responder_id} (keda $ {keep}).
round.accepted: Hungadó {responder_id} a aseptá! Ronda {round_number} ganashi: Hungadó {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, Hungadó {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Total nobo: Hungadó 0: $ {total_0}, Hungadó 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Hungadó {responder_id} a rechasá e oferta! Ronda {round_number} ganashi: Tur dos hungadó +$0. Total ta keda: Hungadó 0: $ {total_0}, Hungadó 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: E proponente mester hasi un oferta usando e formato [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: E kantidat di oferta mester ta un number kompletu válido.
invalid_move.out_of_range: E oferta mester ta entre $0 i ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: No tin oferta aktual pa kontestá.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: E respondente mester [Accept] òf [Reject] e oferta.

outcome.win: Hungadó {winner} a gana ku $ {winner_total} total vs Hungadó {loser} su $ {loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Ambos hungadó a kaba ku ${total} total.
